channel.title: Crypto Front Page
channel.description: Crypto Front Page reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto industry.

item.title: How to finish a fermi swap after a failed attempt
item.description: A failed swap usually leaves the token exchange unapplied, but its network fee may still be spent; check transaction status and balances before retrying.

item.title: Base Cobalt upgrade adds conditional transactions and B20 controls
item.description: Base activated Cobalt on September 30, adding conditional transaction inclusion and B20 rules that change how issuers manage token balances and transfer eligibility.
